title: Enforce decision requested (Segment B trigger)
description: The message Pega sends to start Amendia Segment B (ach-decision-enforce) once the RBO underwriter has decided. Author this schema in the onboarding wizard. The pack's triage rule matches on request_type == "EnforceDecisionRequested"; case_id is the cohort correlation key. rbo_decision is the labelled underwriter decision — capture_decision records it as the `decision` artifact and the pack's exclusive gateway branches on decision.rbo_decision. Field shapes match the mock Pega orchestrator's segment_b_payload.

case_id.description: Pega case id — the cohort correlation_value.

rbo_decision.description: The RBO underwriter's labelled decision — drives the Segment-B gateway (approve → release, reject → purge).
